items.text: COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES

items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the agriculture and markets law, in relation to establishing
the farm ownership succession planning program (FOSPP)
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S2407

SPONSOR: BAILEY
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the agriculture and markets law, in relation to estab-
lishing the farm ownership succession planning program (FOSPP)

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill establishes a farm ownership succession program and resources
to assist current farmers who are planning on retiring, selling or
ending their farming operations in order to ensure that farming oper-
ations can be continued by new owners. The program is also charged with
outreach to minority communities to help increase the number of minority
farmer owners in New York State.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1: The Agriculture and Markets Laws is amended by adding a new
section 323-a to create the Farm Ownership Succession Planning Program
(FOSPP) within the department of agriculture and markets and in conjunc-
tion with the department of economic development and the department of
financial services.

Outlines a list of resources to be made available to farm owners to
assist them in securing new farm ownership and lists other resources
that can help prospective farm owners.

Requires the department of economic development and the department of
financial services to also Make resources available to both farm owners
and prospective buyers. Establishes a multistate marketing effort to
increase the pool of prospective buyers and establishes a diversity in
farming and farm ownership succession planning advisory task force to
ensure the FOSPP is reaching out to prospective farmers and farming
entrepreneurs who are from the list of protected classes in New York
State law.

Sets deadlines for specific actions including dates for selection of
members of the advisory task force and for submission of required
outreach plan under FOSPP.

Section 2: This act shall take effect immediately.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Major demographic changes are impacting every sector of the American
economy and farming is included. Small and family owned and operated
farms have had their share of economic hardships with interstate and
global competition impacting the profitability and interest in small
scale farming. As many current farmers are at retirement age and with
that trend expected to continue, it is important for New York State to
put in place a farm ownership succession program to help these farmers
keep their lands in the agriculture sector when they decide to sell off
their farms, farmlands and their farming assets.  Establishing the farm
owner succession planning program(FOSPP) as outlined in this proposed
legislation will help these hardworking New Yorkers secure the smooth
sale of their operations, help identify prospective buyers and provide
both with the wealth of information on state programs that are in place
to help farmers.

As importantly, the FOSPP program acknowledges that the changing demo-
graphics of our state and nation is seeing a decline in caucasian popu-
lation with dramatic increases in minority populations. To ensure that
these groups have the ability to compete for farming opportunities and
become farm owners, the FOSPP puts in place outreach mechanisms guided
by a required marketing plan that will be shaped by a required diversity
in the farming advisory board. Out of more than 56,000 farms in New York
State, less than 800 are owned by Hispanic, Black, Asian and Native
Americans. This legislation seeks to compile the list of all the
resources available to farmers and related regulations into a tool kit
that will help both the farmer and the prospective farmer understand
their options, risks and opportunities.

A strong and well carried out farm ownership succession planning program
will help current farmers sell their assets to meet their best interests
while helping to increase the diversity of farm ownership, ensure that
farmland is maintained as such, and will support farming communities by
helping to maintain farming operations and their positive economic
impact in those communities.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2021-22: S.6868 - Referred to Agriculture

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Establishes the farm ownership succession planning program to provide farm owners with a succession planning toolkit that can be used by such farm owners who plan on selling or closing their farm.
title: Establishes the farm ownership succession planning program
